name: claude-context-bar
description: Shows Claude Code model and context usage in the VS Code status bar

claudeContextBar.modelColor.description: Color of the model name text. Accepts a hex code (e.g. #4FC3F7) or a VS Code ThemeColor id (e.g. textLink.foreground). Leave empty to use the default status bar foreground.

claudeContextBar.warningThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which the bar/percentage switches to the warning color.

claudeContextBar.dangerThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which the bar/percentage switches to the danger color.

claudeContextBar.normalColor.description: Color used below the warning threshold. Hex code or ThemeColor id.

claudeContextBar.warningColor.description: Color used at/above the warning threshold. Hex code or ThemeColor id.

claudeContextBar.dangerColor.description: Color used at/above the danger threshold. Hex code or ThemeColor id.
